descriptions.cc39d_utf8_decode_8018b360: Decode one UTF-8 sequence of one, two or three bytes to a 16-bit code unit and report its length (a local receives it when no output is supplied); other lead bytes give length 0 and value 0, and continuation bytes are not validated. Counterpart of the admitted 16-bit encoder at 0x8018b2b0; original names unknown.
